title: diffusion.pdf, a PDF that's an image model
excerpt: A PDF with a 55-million-parameter denoising diffusion model embedded within it.
content_html:
So how did I get here? :D

The last two weeks i've been messing around with pdfs. I made slop pdf, a pdf that generates random ai slop stories when you open it, and I was showing that off to one of my friends who suggested I get the LLM to actually work inside the pdf, without an API call to a relay.

I laughed at the idea, but then we did some research together, and we managed to find EvanZhouDev's llm.pdf. Because it existed, I didn't want to waste my time or my tokens building something like it. So I pivoted, eventually deciding to make a diffusion image model work fully inside a pdf.

I forked EvanZhouDev's llm.pdf repo, and eventually managed to get it working (with the help of claude). Here's the finished version.

proof of conceptness disclaimer/warning :p

This model only has 131 Known Objects. If you don't use one of these objects, it will try to map your input to a known object, terribly.

Requirements

  • Chrome or any other chromium browser (minus safari) -- plz note no safari/firefox support
  • at least 75MB of storage (sorry its such a big file )

So is this AI?

Ehh.. it is technically a denoising diffusion model similar to Stable Diffusion, Midjourney or Dall-e but like way worse

I trained this model on 130ish categories using Google's Quick Draw dataset of doodle images. It took me so so long (because I did it on my Macbook Air) but eventually I trained it on enough data, for it to produce recognisable stuff.

This training took alot, and ended up inflating the PDF's size to 78mb :cry:.

Now you may be wondering, how'd i get the noise?.

I get the noise by using the current time, legit the only way to get something noisy from a pdf. ;P

Why is it ASCII art?

It was easier to just render the drawing as 28 rows of text, due to the nature of PDF form fields.

You may notice that the actual generation is inverted, this is so that it shows up well against a white background.

So how fast is it?

  • It takes about 1.8 seconds per step when I have the PDF generating in Chrome on my M5 Macbook Air
  • The PDF has a compute of 0.116 GFLOPS on my my laptop when opened in Chrome (58 Million MAC/s)

les specs

# of Parameters55,403,136 int8
PDF Size75 MB
Vocabulary Size131 doodle categories
Compute886M MAC per image
Speed~15.3s per image (at 58M MAC/s)
Quality0.874 class accuracy
Training45 epochs, 327,500 drawings, final loss 0.2476

roll the credits

Built by me, Alex Van Doren. I'm one of the developers behind Hack Club's Stardance Challenge, I'm a super cool sailor, and I'm also an incoming freshman at Brown University.

This is a fork of the really cool llm.pdf by Evan Zhou, that runs an LLM inside a PDF, the thing I was originally intending to build. Make sure to check out his Youtube Video about it, which honestly explained alot.

I also wanted to credit linuxpdf and DoomPDF by ading2210. They inspired me to experiment within the PDF spec, and the coolest thing about them is that they were actually submitted to a Hack Club program I worked on, The Summer of Making.

Also ty Google, for making the Quick, Draw! dataset.

content_html_zh:
那么我是怎么到这里的呢？ ：D

过去两周我一直在忙着处理pdf文件。 我制作了 slop pdf，这是一个当你打开它时会生成随机 ai slop 故事的 pdf，我向我的一位朋友展示了它，他建议我让 LLM 在 pdf 中实际工作，而不需要对中继进行 API 调用。

我嘲笑这个想法，但后来我们一起做了一些研究，我们设法找到了 EvanZhouDev 的 llm.pdf。 因为它存在，所以我不想浪费我的时间或我的代币来构建类似的东西。 所以我改变了方向，最终决定让扩散图像模型完全在 pdf 中工作。

我分叉了 EvanZhouDev 的 llm.pdf 存储库，并最终设法让它工作（在克劳德的帮助下）。 这是完成的版本。

概念证明免责声明/警告：p

该模型只有 131 个已知对象。 如果您不使用这些对象之一，它会尝试将您的输入映射到已知对象，这非常糟糕。

要求

  • Chrome 或任何其他 chromium 浏览器（不包括 safari）--请注意不支持 safari/firefox
  • 至少 75MB 存储空间（抱歉文件太大了）

那么这就是AI吗？

呃.. 从技术上讲，它是一种降噪扩散模型，类似于稳定扩散、Midjourney 或 Dall-e，但更糟糕

我使用 Google 的涂鸦图像 Quick Draw 数据集在 130 多个类别上训练了这个模型。 我花了很长时间（因为我是在 Macbook Air 上完成的），但最终我用足够的数据训练它，让它产生可识别的东西。

这次训练花费了很多时间，最终将 PDF 的大小扩大到 78mb :cry:。

现在您可能想知道，我是如何得到噪音的？

我通过使用当前时间来获取噪音，这是从 pdf 中获取噪音的唯一方法。 ;P

为什么它是 ASCII 艺术？

由于 PDF 表单字段的性质，将绘图渲染为 28 行文本会更容易。

您可能会注意到实际的生成是倒置的，这样它就可以在白色背景下很好地显示。

那么它有多快呢？

  • 当我在 M5 Macbook Air 上的 Chrome 中生成 PDF 时，每步大约需要 1.8 秒
  • 当我在我的笔记本电脑上用 Chrome 打开该 PDF 时，其计算速度为 0.116 GFLOPS（5800 万个 MAC/秒）

规格

参数数量55,403,136 int8
PDF尺寸75 MB
词汇量131 个涂鸦类别
计算每个图像 886M MAC
Speed每个图像约 15.3 秒（58M MAC/秒）
质量0.874 级精度
训练45个epoch，327,500张图纸，最终损失0.2476

滚动制作人员名单

由我 Alex Van Doren 建造。 我是 Hack Club 星舞挑战赛的开发者之一，我是一名超级酷的水手，也是布朗大学的新生。

这是 Evan Zhou 的非常酷的 llm.pdf 的一个分支，它在 PDF 中运行 LLM，这也是我最初打算构建的东西。 请务必查看他的 Youtube 视频，其中诚实地解释了很多内容。

I also wanted to credit linuxpdf and DoomPDF by ading2210. They inspired me to experiment within the PDF spec, and the coolest thing about them is that they were actually submitted to a Hack Club program I worked on, The Summer of Making.

感谢 Google 制作了《Quick, Draw!》 数据集。
